Graphics feeds

Everything on this page is built from the same data as the site and updates whenever the site does. Point your graphics system at a feed, or add an overlay as a 1920×1080 browser source. No sign-up or key needed.

Data feeds

One flat row per team, in district-standings order. Works with vMix Data Sources, Ross XPression DataLinq (JSON / HTTP), NewBlue Captivate, Singular, and anything that reads CSV.

FeedFormatWhat’s in it
standings.json · .csvJSON array / CSVAll 13 Northeast Indiana FRC teams: rank, team, short name (≤ 20 characters), short school name, city, W-L-T, district points, Indiana rank, honors line, EPA, logo URLs, team page, updated date.
top10.json · .csvJSON array / CSVThe first ten rows of the standings: the Top 10.
schedule.json · .csvJSON array / CSVEvery 2026–27 FTC and FRC event: dates, venue, city, local teams entered (once posted), event link.
ticker.txtPlain textOne line per team for a crawl or ticker, e.g. #1 Team THRUST (1501, Huntington County 4-H Robotics) · 45-15 · 250 pts · Won Mishawaka, Lafayette · World Championship · 3 judged awards

Order and points: official FIRST Indiana district points, via The Blue Alliance. The epa column is EPA (Expected Points Added), Statbotics’ estimate of how many points a robot adds to its alliance’s score in an average match, like points per game. It is a secondary column and does not set the order. Absolute URL for any feed: https://horner.github.io/refintery-rankings/feeds/standings.json

Overlays (browser sources)

Add as a browser source at 1920 × 1080. Backgrounds are transparent by default, and every graphic stays inside the 90% title-safe area. The overlay re-reads the data every minute.

GraphicURL
Full-screen standings (8 per page)overlay.html?view=standings · page 2: &page=2
Full-screen Top 10overlay.html?view=top10
Team lower thirdoverlay.html?view=lowerthird&team=1501 (any team number)
Standings crawloverlay.html?view=ticker · speed: &speed=120 pixels/second

Options (add to any overlay URL):

  • &bg=green chroma green, &bg=black, or &bg=navy for switchers without alpha. Default is transparent.
  • &cycle=10 flips standings pages every 10 seconds.
  • &rows=6 changes rows per page.
  • &safe=1 shows action-safe (blue) and title-safe (pink) guides while you line things up.

Preview of the standings overlay with safe-area guides. The checkerboard is transparency.

Using these on air

  • During a match, FIRST requires its own unmodified audience-display overlay on streams of its events. Use these graphics for standings, results and team introductions before and after matches.
  • Logos are the teams’ and schools’ own marks; see the logo credits.
  • The ranking is not a poll. It is the official district-points order, so it matches what FIRST Indiana publishes.
